description: Reusable minimal real-QVT 2-D ICP electron-particle diffusion diagnostic for isolating geometry, transport-table, and thermal wall-loss behavior before adding drift, Poisson, reactions, or electron-energy evolution.
objective: Establish a reusable 2-D ICP electron-only diffusion baseline with fixed mean electron energy and table-derived transport.
target_claims: electron particle diffusion runs on the real ICP RZ plasma geometry without electrostatic coupling
thermal wall loss at zero sheath potential depletes electron inventory
fixed mean electron energy drives a constant diffusivity through the production transport-table lookup path
constraints: electron mean energy fixed at 5.73276 eV
electron diffusivity obtained from electron_moments.txt through PhysicsElectronClosureMaterial
all named plasma boundaries use thermal electron collection with sheath potential fixed to 0 V
no electric field or volumetric source
